title: PsySpace: Simulating Emergent Psychological Dynamics in Long-Duration Space Missions using Multi-Agent LLMs

contributions.purpose: 用多智能体 LLM 模拟航天员心理动态
contributions.mechanism: 双组件心理模型(静态五因素人格 Pi + 动态 stress/loneliness 状态向量),LLM 反射函数 fLLM 依据事件与自身回复更新状态
contributions.evaluation: 5 模型×4 任务场景×10 次迭代;定性复现 Mars-500 third-quarter 效应(无真实逐日数据,literature 对照)
contributions.domain: 空间心理学 / 生成式智能体仿真
contributions.source_quote: We propose a novel agent architecture where LLMs are endowed with persistent, quantifiable, and dynamic psychological states that directly influence their linguistic behavior

contributions.purpose: 建立评测 AI 社会/情感智能的基准
contributions.mechanism: 用真实 analog 任务(HI-SEAS I/II/IV、Mars-500)事件驱动,定义 Crew Cohesion、Psychological Keystone Index、Linguistic Coping Profile 等指标
contributions.evaluation: Mars-500 中 GPT-4.1-nano 内聚 0.916 最高;GPT 系 Emotion-Focused、Gemma3-27b Problem-Focused,呈不同'行为指纹'
contributions.source_quote: We establish a new benchmark for evaluating the social and emotional intelligence of AI agents by grounding their simulated interactions against psychological outcome data from real-world analog space missions.

contributions.purpose: 因果测量 AI 支持干预对封闭社会系统的效果
contributions.mechanism: 引入 CBT 提示的 Psychological Support Agent(PSA),自举 A/B + 10000 次置换检验
contributions.evaluation: HI-SEAS IV GPT-4.1-mini 压力 0.291→0.188(-35%,p<0.001);但 nano p=0.1305、Qwen3 p=0.1032、Gemma3 p=0.3455 不显著
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate the first use of an interactive AI support agent within a multi-agent simulation to causally measure the effects of targeted psychological interventions on a closed social system.

self_declared_provenance.quote: PsySpace leverages this technology but tailors it to astronaut-relevant dynamics: each agent in the framework has a persistent personality and emotional state influenced by mission events, enabling the study of phenomena like morale decline or conflict spirals that generic generative agents did not address.
PsySpace takes a different approach: it endows agents with richer cognitive-emotional models and uses data-driven language model logic rather than brittle heuristics.

notes: 自声明 3 条贡献。核心数据红旗:全部'实证'数据均为 LLM 生成的仿真值,并非真实人类数据;'validation against real-world'只是定性叙事对照文献 third-quarter 效应——论文自认'Direct access to the raw, day-by-day psychological data from the original Mars-500 mission was not possible'。循环自证:agent 状态由 LLM 解读其自身回复更新(∆Si,t=fLLM),PSA 干预成功与否又由另一次 LLM 调用判定——数据、解读、评判全由 LLM 闭环,无外部 ground truth。负结果/trade-off(带数字):PSA 对 GPT-4.1-nano(p=0.1305)、Qwen3-30b(p=0.1032)、Gemma3-27b(p=0.3455)效果不显著;量化模型内聚更低、偏 Problem-Focused,模型大小 vs 社会智能保真度权衡。Checklist 自曝造数/AI 披露:AI Involvement 全部 [D](假设/设计/分析/写作均 AI 完成),'Everything was done by AI','AI did all the writing';Figure 制作='AI generated an empty shell of the design and told the human authors how to fill it'(占位图隐患)。Checklist 内部矛盾:Paper Checklist Q8 compute resources 答 [No]'does not specify the hardware',但正文 Appendix D 明确给出 A100 80GB / RTX 6000 Ada、~3600 GPU 小时、$173.43——checklist 与正文自相矛盾(幻影/不一致自报)。
